description_i18n.zh: 精选生姜搭配陈皮，融入麦芽糖慢火熬制而成。姜香醇厚微辛，陈皮清香解腻，甜而不齁，温润适口。质地柔韧适中，不会过分坚硬，采用传统手工熬糖工艺，风味地道，是一款富有潮汕特色的风味糖果。
description_i18n.en: This flavour candy is slowly simmered with maltose, fresh ginger and preserved tangerine peel. It has mellow, gentle spiciness from ginger, balanced by the refreshing aroma of tangerine peel. Not overly sweet, it delivers a comforting taste. With a moderately firm, pliable texture instead of being rock‑hard, it is crafted by traditional hand‑boiling techniques, a classic Chaoshan‑style confectionery.
